authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11165 lohita blood lists L. lahū/awāṇ lāū, regional lūī/loī, and expressly Kho. lei in its addendum. The survey lateral/rounded-vowel forms match these blood comparanda. Reviewed comparison: Kal loī “blood” (f_buwn726qnc46e). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
